name: ZeroPlayer
note: Online shop for official football merchandise (zeroplayer.it), AC Monza's sleeve sponsor from the 2026-27 kit; the wordmark on the shirt reads 'ZeroPlayer by 3R Sport'. ZeroPlayer's own Dati Societari page (https://zeroplayer.it/pages/dati-societari-20220304, checked 2026-10-03) names Cav. Rimaudo Group s.r.l., Via Giuseppe Saragat 6, Milano (P.IVA 07247960961, REA MI-1946655, share capital EUR 115,000) as the company behind the shop, with the operating site given as 'ZeroPlayer, Via Curtatone 4, 20037 Paderno Dugnano (MI)' - the same address as 3R Sport S.r.l.'s sede operativa (https://3rsport.com/pages/dati-societari-20220304). Its privacy policy likewise names CAV. RIMAUDO GROUP S.R.L. as data controller (https://zeroplayer.it/policies/privacy-policy). Who owns Rimaudo Group is not stated on these pages, and a company-register entry is not an owner (CONTRIBUTING.md), so no ownership claim was written and the sponsor stays not rated yet. shop.acmonza.com's footer reads '(c) Copyright 2026 GTZ Distribution'; the relationship between GTZ Distribution, Rimaudo Group and 3R Sport is unclear.
